reports.title: The Everyday Knit Straight & Wide Leg
reports.summary: Knitted pants gain definition through a clean open hem and a deliberate full-length leg. Straight and controlled wide-leg shapes offer two clear options, with loopback and smoother double-jersey routes changing the body and fall of the garment. A quiet waist and side seam keep the comfort story visually composed.
reports.whyMarks: Shambhala comfort pants and wider active bottoms provide a familiar Mark’s foundation. Cleaner leg balance and a more considered knit offer specific ways to develop that everyday role.
reports.whatChanges: Develop straight and wide versions separately, with a smooth-front waist and discreet internal adjustment. Compare loopback with double jersey, then refine pocket bags and hem depth around each fabric’s body and recovery.
elements: Two explicit blocks: an open-hem straight leg and a controlled wide leg; both full-length.
Smooth-front elastic waist with an internal flat drawcord as a sampling option.
Side-entry pockets evaluated for bag visibility and opening stability in the chosen knit.
Quiet side seams and a substantial, flat hem; check twist and drag on footwear.
Women’s and men’s rises, seat balance and thigh ease developed independently.

Fine mélange as a separate yarn-colour option; no printed texture is required.

reports.title: The Brushed Warm-Up Jogger
reports.summary: The winter jogger combines a soft inner face with a cleaner outer line. Relaxed volume through the seat and thigh is brought into focus by a gathered hem, while a flat drawcord and controlled waistband keep details quiet. Loopback and brushed-back jersey provide different readings of tactile comfort.
reports.whyMarks: Fleece joggers and comfort bottoms are familiar Mark’s items. A more resolved inner handle, leg proportion and hem treatment give this winter development a distinct focus.
reports.whatChanges: Compare a fixed gathered hem with a concealed adjustable opening. Balance relaxed thigh ease against ankle volume, then resolve waistband channels, pocket bulk and the brushed interior together on the finished garment.
elements: Relaxed seat and thigh, tapering into a purposeful gathered hem.
Optional concealed hem adjustment for a straight-to-jogger conversion; test it as a functional variant.
Multi-channel elastic waist with flat woven drawcord; hardware kept visually discreet.
Useful side pockets with controlled opening and bag bulk.
Plain face or small tonal stitch detail, rather than large source-brand graphics.

materials.question: Process: raise the inner face of a knitted ground. Compare hand feel, shedding and pilling; brushing is not a fibre or a quantified insulation claim.

materials.name: Soft double jersey alternative
materials.question: Construction: two faces, with fibre blend selected later. Does it give sufficient body and comfort without a raised inner surface?

patterns: Heathered grey and muted mélange are yarn-colour routes.
Quiet solids support the winter comfort story; any wash variation needs a controlled approval standard.
processes: Compare unbrushed, lightly brushed and more raised inner-face options on identified base qualities.
Assess pilling, lint transfer, shrinkage, drawcord security and hem-adjuster comfort.

sourceJoins.role: Direct item evidence for relaxed fit, elastic waist, flat cord, adjustable gathered hem and loopback/brushed lining.

reports.cardSummary: A soft inner face, relaxed leg and purposeful gathered hem refine the winter jogger.

reports.title: Studio Leggings
reports.summary: A quiet, close-fitting legging brings the season’s next-to-skin knit direction into a focused studio development. Fine rib and smooth compact jersey offer different surface readings, with a flat high waist and considered seam placement defining the line. Full-length and 7/8 versions allow proportion to be assessed separately from texture.
reports.whyMarks: Shambhala’s existing leggings establish a clear Mark’s use case. The opportunity is a more resolved relationship between surface, waist and movement within a familiar active-bottoms category.
reports.whatChanges: Compare smooth and fine-rib prototypes in the intended fit. Refine high-waist stability, crotch and inner-leg construction through movement trials, and develop any seamless version as its own engineering route.
elements: Close-fitting leg line, with full-length and 7/8 lengths evaluated as distinct options.
Flat high waist tested for rolling, digging and movement; no unverified tummy-control claim.
Crotch/inner-leg construction selected through movement and comfort trials.
Smooth or fine-rib surface with discreet seam placement and restrained branding.
Separate cut-and-sew and seamless prototypes if both routes are pursued.

reports.title: Loopback and Brushed-Back Jersey
reports.summary: Loopback and brushed-back jersey offer two distinct inner handles for everyday knit pants. A clean outer face keeps the leg line composed, while the inside can remain looped or take on a softly raised surface. Cloth body and local thickness are developed around the intended straight or gathered silhouette.
reports.whyMarks: Comfort pants and joggers already belong to Mark’s offer. Distinct face-and-back combinations give the material programme a clear relationship to fit and seasonal handle.
reports.whatChanges: Compare loopback and lightly raised inner faces on identified base qualities. Review drape, knee recovery, waist bulk and pocket construction in the intended garment.
elements: Loopback refers to interior loops. Single/double jersey describes knitted structure. Brushed fleece combines a knitted ground with a raised surface.

materials.name: Fibre & material

reports.title: Structured Double Jersey for Clean Knit Trousers
reports.summary: Double jersey brings a more defined body to everyday knitted trousers. Smooth faces and low-relief tonal structures offer different surface readings, with the cloth selected to support a clean straight or measured wide leg. The direction connects a composed appearance with the movement of a knitted construction.
reports.whyMarks: Mark’s comfort-bottoms wardrobe gives structured jersey a clear use. A more deliberate cloth body can refine how an everyday knitted trouser falls and holds its line.
reports.whatChanges: Compare a smooth double jersey with a subtly structured alternative in the same trouser block. Resolve pocket shape, waist gathering and hem depth around each quality’s drape and recovery.
elements: Double jersey is a construction family, not proof of a particular commercial ponte/scuba quality or four-way stretch.

reports.title: Fine Rib & Smooth Jersey for Studio Leggings
reports.summary: Fine rib and smooth compact jersey offer two surface routes for studio leggings. A quiet appearance keeps the focus on the close-fitting line, while coverage and shape retention are developed in the intended garment. Seamless engineering and cut-and-sew construction remain distinct options within this focused material study.
reports.whyMarks: Shambhala leggings provide a familiar Mark’s use case. A controlled surface and considered relationship between cloth, waist and movement give the material development a precise purpose.
reports.whatChanges: Compare fine rib with a smooth jersey in the intended high-rise fit. Assess coverage through bending, recovery after wear and the comfort of seams or knitted transitions.
elements: Rib is knitted structure; seamless is a garment-engineering route; interlock is a fabric construction. They are not synonyms.

materials.name: Fibre & material
materials.question: Cotton/cellulosic blends and elastic components are candidate routes. Neither a fibre name nor the source’s bra-specific interlock establishes leggings compression, breathability or moisture management.

materials.name: Construction
materials.question: Rib is knitted structure; seamless is a garment-engineering route; interlock is a fabric construction. They are not synonyms.

patterns: Use solid or fine mélange initially. Seamless zoning or rib variation is engineered texture, not automatically print.

limitations: These sources do not establish a yoga-specific A/W 27/28 growth rate, technical fabric certification or finished garment performance.
reports.cardSummary: Fine rib and smooth compact jersey offer distinct surfaces for a quiet, close-fitting studio legging.

reports.title: A Controlled Waist and Convertible Hem
reports.summary: Discreet waist and hem construction gives knit pants more control over shape. A flat drawcord and considered elastic channels keep the waist composed, while an optional concealed hem cincher allows the leg to move between open and gathered. The detail is developed around comfort, adjustment and the uncinched silhouette.
reports.whyMarks: Comfort pants and joggers are familiar Mark’s items. A well-resolved waist and optional hem adjustment give a useful construction focus within those established shapes.
reports.whatChanges: Develop a permanent open hem and an adjustable version separately. Resolve channel bulk, drawcord security and adjuster position, then review the leg with the hem both open and gathered.
elements: Adjustment security and ease of use
Local thickness and comfort
Drawcord/hardware care compatibility
Fit with hem open and gathered
processes: Waistband assembly, drawcord and hem-adjustment construction. Not a textile fibre, print or finish.
limitations: This is a source-backed construction option; no trim supplier or tested assembly is confirmed.
reports.cardSummary: Flat drawcords, considered elastic channels and concealed hem adjustment refine the shape of knit pants.
